{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsAjobYgr7vKLrDRY688","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WHGKyQQEyN692Fgp7PSosD","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\nc = pd.read_csv('dataset/companies.csv').set_index('company_id')\ni = pd.read_csv('dataset/invoices.csv')\nids = set(c.index)\n\nbenford = np.log10(1 + 1/np.arange(1, 10))\ni['d1'] = i.net_amount.astype(str).str.lstrip('0.').str[0].astype(int)\n\nrows = []\nfor sid, g in i.groupby('seller_id'):\n    if sid not in ids: continue\n    n = len(g)\n    obs = np.array([(g.d1 == d).sum() for d in range(1, 10)]) / n\n    mad = np.abs(obs - benford).mean()\n    chi2 = n * ((obs - benford)**2 / benford).sum()\n    rows.append((sid, n, mad, chi2, (g.d1 >= 5).mean()))\ndf = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['sid','n','mad','chi2','frac_ge5'])\nprint('invoice count per seller distribution:')\nprint(df.n.describe())\nprint()\nprint('Top by chi2 (sellers with n>=15):')\nprint(df[df.n >= 15].sort_values('chi2', ascending=False).head(15).to_string(index=False))\nprint()\nprint('Top by MAD (n>=15):')\nprint(df[df.n >= 15].sort_values('mad', ascending=False).head(15).to_string(index=False))\nEOF","description":"Compute Benford leading-digit deviation per seller"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1478,"cache_read_input_tokens":24109,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1478,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"93a04d05-44cc-4f9b-aa93-2f7808a22273","uuid":"a1c1166a-642d-4e47-ae42-a2289bf2f5fc","request_id":"req_011CcsAjnx6w5hp45awTXHC7"}
